writeups.title: TSRX: The Next Evolution of React Development
writeups.summary: TSRX treats UI as statements instead of JSX expressions, so components stay closer to how the interface is actually described.

writeups.title: Introducing pagination-core — Headless, Isomorphic Pagination for JavaScript/Typescript
writeups.summary: A dependency-free pagination library with the logic only: it runs in the browser and on Node, and leaves the UI to you.

writeups.title: React Re-renders Explained: The Mental Model Most Developers Miss
writeups.summary: A re-render is the component function running again. The DOM update is a separate step, and that split is where most performance confusion starts.

writeups.title: Learning a New Framework or Tool: Why Manual Setup Matters More Than CLI Shortcuts
writeups.summary: Scaffolding a React app by hand shows what each file, dependency, and build tool is for before a CLI hides that structure.

writeups.title: Setup React app with webpack(TS and JS)
writeups.summary: A from-scratch React and webpack setup in JavaScript, then the same app migrated to TypeScript, without Create React App.

writeups.title: Understanding Redux Middleware
writeups.summary: Middleware sits between dispatch and the reducers. applyMiddleware is how redux-thunk, redux-logger, and similar tools wrap the store.
